name: An Thuong
kicker: Bar and kitchen lanes behind My Khe
summary: Walk the small streets a few blocks inland from My Khe after dark, when the bars, kitchens, lanterns, and spa boards light up close enough to wander between. The quarter runs from the beach road at Vo Nguyen Giap inland to Chau Thi Vinh Te. Give it the evening after a swim, and skip it if you sleep on the river and want an early night.
fee: No ticket for the streets. Kalà Kalà entry is free. Drinks: check on arrival.
getThere: Walk west from a My Khe hotel. A short Grab from the river.
heroCaption: A doorway on An Thuong 4 at night

notice.title: From the river it is a ride
notice.body: The lanes sit behind My Khe, across the Han River from the old center. If you sleep on the river, plan a Grab each way rather than a walk after dinner.

body: Come after the swim and walk the small streets inland of My Khe. The city named this tourist quarter in January 2018 and set the name stone that April at the corner of Vo Nguyen Giap and Hoang Ke Viem. It covers about 0.15 km², beach included, and counted 141 businesses serving visitors in 2018.

The lanes are the night: bars and kitchens a block or two from the sand. On the beach road, Kalà Kalà at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap is the club on the sand, free to enter and open late. East West Brewing’s taproom faces My Khe and pours until 01:00. Those two sit on the sand. They are not the lanes.
The night market at No. 4 An Thuong 4 is a separate stop: about 40 stalls, open in the evening and free to enter. Treat it as one stall row, not the quarter.

figures.caption: Tran Bach Dang, one block in from the beach road, late afternoon
figures.alt: A paved street inside the An Thuong quarter with red lanterns, lit spa boards, parked motorbikes, and hotel fronts

gettingThere: The quarter begins at Vo Nguyen Giap, the beach road behind My Khe. The name stone stands at the Hoang Ke Viem corner, and the lanes run inland as far as Chau Thi Vinh Te. Walk in from a hotel on that stretch of sand. From a Han River hotel, cross the river by Grab.

legs.heading: From My Khe
legs.body: Walk. Turn inland off Vo Nguyen Giap at Hoang Ke Viem or Ngo Thi Si.

legs.heading: From the Han River
legs.body: By Grab or taxi across the river.

hours: Lanes: no set hours. Kalà Kalà: 08:00–02:00 (its FAQ) or 08:00–midnight (its footer). East West Brewing: 08:00–01:00. An Thuong 4 night market: 17:00–23:00 (city markets page, 2023).
admissionNote: No ticket for the streets. Kalà Kalà entry is free. An Thuong 4 night market is free to enter (2023 listing). Drinks: check on arrival.
